summary: Largest US competitive power producer (gas + nuclear) with retail arm; benefits from data-centre power demand and nuclear PPAs; strong buybacks.

rationale.growthHigh: Power prices and data-centre contracts lift revenue ~7% a year; generation is a mature business.
rationale.targetMargin: Recent operating margin ~20-23% with hedged gross margin rising; 24% assumes long-term contracts at higher prices.
rationale.salesToCapital: Power plants are capital-heavy; ~$1 of new revenue per $1 invested.
rationale.exitMultiple: 18x year-5 earnings: a premium to old utilities (~15x) for contracted data-centre growth.

thesis.text: Vistra owns a large gas and nuclear fleet in Texas and the US East with a retail business that stabilises margins. Data-centre demand and nuclear contracts are re-rating power assets; buybacks shrink the share count.
bull: Nuclear PPAs with hyperscalers at premium prices
Rising power demand in ERCOT/PJM lifts gas plant margins
bear: Power prices and spark spreads are cyclical
